authorization.T0: C0 M5 Net, one four-geometry train-only diagnostic fit
authorization.T1: G0 OrderedPeriodicG0, one four-geometry train-only diagnostic fit

checkpoint_selection: Diagnostic only: save initialization, final step-1500 state and the minimum data-loss state over all 1501 evaluated states. No held-out or validation selection; no formal-candidate selection.

T0.architecture: frozen M5 Net: 6-32-32 encoder, seven order-local 2-score heads, 14-32-14 residual fusion
T0.initialization: torch.manual_seed(0), exact frozen M5 constructor default Linear initialization

T1.architecture: frozen G0 OrderedPeriodicG0 with hidden width 4, three directed periodic-ring message rounds, physical-order readout and same seven rank-2 heads/fusion
T1.initialization: Python/NumPy/torch seeds reset to 0, exact frozen G0 constructor default Linear initialization

constant_baselines.train_mean: per-coordinate mean of the outer-train target for the all-32-fold saved-checkpoint audit, and per-coordinate mean of the selected four targets for the diagnostic-fit comparison; evaluated with the matching fit's original scale
constant_baselines.zero: raw latent score prediction 0; because the frozen objective divides by std but does not subtract target mean, this is the exact standardized-latent-zero baseline under the actual loss

interpretation_limits: Train-only diagnostic; no held-out evaluation, no H1 admission claim, and no evidence of physical correctness or 32-geometry generalization.
loss: mean(((predicted_latent - target_latent)/max(population_std(four train targets per coordinate),1e-12))**2); no explicit weight-decay term is added to logged data loss.

metrics.oracle_pca_floor: decode true four-geometry latent scores through the same outer-train rank-2 basis; report frozen H1 state error separately from model train error
metrics.output_variance: per-coordinate population variance across the four outputs; report output/target variance ratios and per-coordinate prediction-target correlations
metrics.raw_latent_mse: mean squared error in unscaled PCA-score units
metrics.state_error: frozen H1 complex-state relative RMSE per geometry using training truth only; summarize median/q95/worst across the four geometries

outer_fold.selection_rule: sort outer-train case IDs lexicographically and select first four; determined from frozen fold manifest only

preprocessing.PCA: reuse deterministic per-order rank-2 Cartesian PCA basis fitted on all 31 outer-train geometries; fold-local preprocessing state is not serialized in prior artifacts, so reconstruct the same fit from those 31 train rows only and verify explained-variance parity against saved outer_pca record
preprocessing.geometry_scaler: reuse outer-fold StandardScaler fitted on all 31 outer-train geometries; transform selected four only
preprocessing.loss_scale: for each diagnostic fit, recompute per-score population std on the four diagnostic training targets exactly as frozen lossfn does; floor 1e-12; no centering
preprocessing.target_order: orders -3..+3, 2 Cartesian scores per order; no held-out data

saved_checkpoint_audit.C0: audit only saved C0 split/epoch provenance and any available training metrics; no C0 LOGO refit; no parameter audit if checkpoint tensors are absent
saved_checkpoint_audit.scope: all 32 G0 outer folds x seeds 0/1/2; use each saved final parameter vector and evaluate only that fold's 31 outer-train geometries; never evaluate held-out geometry

snapshots.semantics: checkpoint after exactly s optimizer updates; evaluate fit loss/state error/output variance then calculate gradient norm at that snapshot without an optimizer update; last_update_norm is the parameter displacement of update s; at step 0 it is null. Minimum-loss checkpoint is tracked over step 0 through every post-update state.

training_rows: 4 geometry samples; each row target carries the full 21-wavelength spectrum through the frozen seven-order rank-2 PCA scores; full batch of four.
